sub_sector.value: Massachusetts personal auto insurance; homeowners and business owners insurance

financial_business_type.detail: Writes auto, home and business owners property and casualty insurance in Massachusetts, New Hampshire and Maine.

revenue_driver.detail: Earns premiums on policies it underwrites, plus investment income on its portfolio.

customer_type.detail: Mainly individual drivers and homeowners, plus small business owners, sold through independent agents.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Carries underwriting risk and pays claims on its own policies, with weather catastrophe exposure.
